# Wiqonn

> AI lab of data and software based in Barranquilla, Colombia. We audit, build,
> fine-tune and operate AI for companies of any size, anywhere in the world —
> fixed price in writing, results measured from day one.

## Who we are

- AI lab operated from Barranquilla, Colombia, working worldwide in Spanish and English.
- Full-stack coverage: from raw data to production systems (AI, data, cloud, IoT, embedded).
- Applied research embedded in every delivery: we publish and evaluate models with academic rigor.
- We build, fine-tune and deploy AI on our own hardware: DGX Spark (Blackwell GB10) and Apple Silicon, keeping client data private and on-premise.

## What we do

- Custom AI models: machine learning models built from scratch and trained on your data (predictive models, classification, forecasting, anomaly detection).
- Custom LLM fine-tuning: fine-tuning open models (e.g. SmolLM3-3B, Llama) with LoRA and 4-bit NVFP4/MXFP8 quantization on Blackwell GPUs — private models trained on your own data.
- Custom AI agents: autonomous agents that automate workflows, answer customers and operate 24/7, trained and grounded on your company's data.
- LLM/RAG applications: document Q&A, knowledge management, semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation in Spanish and English.
- Computer vision: defect detection, OCR/document processing, visual inspection, medical imaging.
- Business Intelligence: executive dashboards, automated reports, real-time KPI tracking.
- Cloud and Infrastructure: multi-cloud architecture, high availability, production-grade security, MLOps pipelines.
- Custom Development: web and mobile apps, APIs, integration with your existing systems.

## Applied research

- Model evaluation with real data and academic rigor — we test claims before we ship.
- Benchmarks on local inference: vLLM-MLX on Apple Silicon (464 tok/s on M4 Max, 200+ models, zero API cost).
- Fine-tuning pipelines on DGX Spark: NVFP4 (E2M1) and MXFP8 training with Transformer Engine, TensorRT-LLM serving.
- If it doesn't work on your data, we tell you before you spend.

## How we work

- AI Readiness Audit: use-case prioritization by ROI and a roadmap with phases and costs.
- Outcome-based pilots: KPI defined and measurable from day one, proven with real metrics before scaling.
- Managed AI Ops: managed operations, monitoring, retraining and model evolution with SLA.
- Fractional AI Leadership: AI direction and CTO-as-a-service.
- IP / White-Label: validated AI solutions licensed for integrators and consultancies.
- Fixed price in writing, no hidden costs, no lock-in.
